How Much Does a Dental Clinic Renovation Cost in Burnaby, BC?

A dental clinic renovation in Burnaby or Metro Vancouver costs between $85 and $220 per square foot for a standard dental tenant improvement, according to 2026 real project data. A complete build-out for a new dental practice — including operatories, sterilization room, X-ray area, and reception — typically runs $150,000 to $350,000 for a 1,200–2,000 square foot space. That figure covers BC Building Code compliance, Fraser Health permitting, and professional finish work that meets CDA (Canadian Dental Association) infection control standards.

Reno Stars recently completed a dental clinic renovation in Burnaby, BC that demonstrates what real 2026 pricing looks like. The project included a full reception redesign, three operatories with new dental chairs, a sterilization centre, and an X-ray room — all to current Fraser Health standards. The final cost reflected the specific requirements that apply to medical tenant improvements in BC: upgraded HVAC for airborne infection control, specialized vinyl flooring in operatories, and proper backflow prevention on all water lines serving dental chairs.

What Drives Dental Clinic Renovation Cost in BC?

Three factors dominate the cost of a dental clinic renovation in Metro Vancouver: the scope of the dental equipment rough-in, BC building code requirements for medical occupancies, and Fraser Health Authority permitting requirements. Each adds a distinct cost layer that general commercial contractors often miss.

Dental Equipment Rough-In

Dental chairs, delivery systems, and X-ray equipment require dedicated electrical circuits (typically 20-amp dedicated lines per chair), compressed air lines, high-volume suction, and isolated waste connections. Each operatory rough-in typically costs $2,500–$5,500 in 2026, depending on whether the space is a new build-out or a replacement in an existing suite. A three-operatory clinic therefore adds $7,500–$16,500 in specialized rough-in alone — above and beyond standard electrical and plumbing.

BC Building Code: Medical Occupancy Requirements

A dental clinic is classified as a Group D (care or care with sleeping) occupancy under the BC Building Code, which imposes specific requirements on ventilation, lighting, and fire separation. Key requirements include:

  • Mechanical ventilation supplying outdoor air at minimum 25 CFM per occupant in operatories
  • HVAC systems capable of maintaining negative pressure in surgical/sterilization areas to contain airborne particles
  • Fire-rated separation between the clinic and adjacent commercial tenants — typically a 1-hour fire separation for a mixed-use building
  • Accessible washrooms for patients (including barrier-free dimensions per BC's Accessible Building Requirements)

Fraser Health Authority Permitting

Any dental clinic in Burnaby, Coquitlam, or other Fraser Health region requires a Freestanding Radiation Apparatus permit from Fraser Health for X-ray equipment, in addition to the standard municipal building permit from the City of Burnaby. The permit application must include equipment specifications, room shielding calculations (for panoramic and intraoral X-ray units), and a floor plan showing the X-ray unit's location relative to other occupied spaces. Lead shielding requirements are calculated per CSA N855 standards and typically add $3,000–$8,000 to a project involving X-ray, depending on room dimensions.

A new solo practice build-out runs higher per square foot than a renovation of an existing dental space (because existing rough-ins are reused). Multi-chair group practices with in-house labs or CBCT (cone-beam CT) scanning rooms will exceed the upper range.

How Long Does a Dental Clinic Renovation Take in Burnaby?

A dental clinic renovation in Burnaby or Metro Vancouver typically takes 12–20 weeks from permit submission to handover — similar to other medical tenant improvements in BC. The permitting timeline is typically the longest phase: City of Burnaby building permits for commercial tenant improvements run 4–8 weeks in 2026, and Fraser Health X-ray permits add another 3–5 weeks on top of that. Construction itself for a three-to-four operatory clinic takes 8–12 weeks.

The earliest you can realistically open is approximately five months from when you sign a contractor agreement — a timeline that most dental practice owners underestimate when planning a transition or expansion.

What Dentists in Metro Vancouver Should Know Before Starting

If you are a dentist or clinic owner in Burnaby, Coquitlam, Surrey, or elsewhere in Metro Vancouver planning a renovation, three things will determine your success: contractor experience with medical occupancies, early engagement with Fraser Health, and a clear equipment specification before construction starts.

General commercial contractors regularly underestimate the specialized rough-in requirements for dental equipment. Choosing a contractor who has completed dental clinic or other Group D occupancy projects in BC will avoid costly change orders mid-construction — particularly around HVAC negative pressure specifications and X-ray room shielding, where mistakes are expensive to fix after walls are closed.

Frequently Asked Questions: Dental Clinic Renovation in BC

Do I need a building permit for a dental clinic renovation in Burnaby?

Yes. Any renovation to a dental clinic — including changes to walls, flooring, HVAC, or plumbing — requires a building permit from the City of Burnaby. Because a dental clinic is a Group D (care) occupancy under the BC Building Code, all work must be designed and inspected to the BC Building Code's standards for medical occupancies. Additionally, if the renovation involves X-ray equipment, you need a separate Freestanding Radiation Apparatus permit from Fraser Health Authority before installation.

How much does it cost to build out a dental operatory in BC?

Each dental operatory (the room containing a dental chair and delivery system) costs approximately $15,000–$30,000 to build out in a Metro Vancouver renovation in 2026. This includes the dental rough-in (dedicated electrical, compressed air, high-volume suction, and isolated waste connections), specialized seamless vinyl flooring, upgraded HVAC for infection control, and all finishes. The per-operatory cost is higher for new build-outs than for renovations of existing dental spaces, where some rough-ins may already be in place.

What are the BC Building Code requirements for dental clinic ventilation?

The BC Building Code requires mechanical ventilation supplying outdoor air at minimum 25 CFM per occupant in dental operatories. Sterilization rooms and surgical areas must be maintained at negative pressure relative to adjacent spaces to contain airborne contamination. Dedicated exhaust ventilation is required for X-ray developer equipment and any area where nitrous oxide (laughing gas) is used. An HVAC system upgrade to meet these requirements typically costs $12,000–$25,000 for a standard three-operatory clinic.

How long does it take to get a Fraser Health X-ray permit for a dental clinic?

Fraser Health Authority's Freestanding Radiation Apparatus permit process typically takes 3–5 weeks for a straightforward dental X-ray installation, assuming complete documentation (equipment specifications, shielding calculations per CSA N855, floor plan). More complex installations involving panoramic or cone-beam CT (CBCT) equipment require additional shielding reviews and can take 6–8 weeks. This is in addition to the City of Burnaby building permit timeline, so factor both into your project schedule.

Can a general commercial contractor do a dental clinic renovation in BC?

A general commercial contractor can manage a dental clinic renovation, but they must understand BC Building Code Group D occupancy requirements, Fraser Health Authority standards, and the specialized rough-in requirements for dental equipment. Misunderstanding any of these can result in failed inspections, costly remediation, or Fraser Health permit denial. Reno Stars has completed dental clinic and other medical occupancy renovations in Metro Vancouver and is familiar with the complete regulatory framework including City of Burnaby permits, Fraser Health X-ray permits, and BC Building Code compliance.

高贵林牙科诊所装修费用是多少？

根据2026年真实项目数据，高贵林或大温地区的牙科诊所装修标准医疗商铺改造费用为每平方英尺85至220加元。新建牙科诊所的完整装修——包括诊疗室、消毒室、X光室和接待处——1,200至2,000平方英尺的空间通常在15万至35万加元之间。该费用涵盖BC省建筑规范合规性、Fraser Health许可，以及符合加拿大牙科协会（CDA）感染控制标准的专业装修工程。

聚星裝修近期在BC省高贵林完成了一个牙科诊所装修项目，展示了2026年真实定价。该项目包括接待处全面翻新、三间配备新牙科治疗椅的诊疗室、一间消毒中心及X光室——全部符合当前Fraser Health标准。最终费用反映了适用于BC省医疗商铺改造的具体要求：升级通风系统以控制空气传播感染、诊疗室专用乙烯基地板，以及牙科治疗椅所有水管的后置防止回流装置。

BC省牙科诊所装修费用的主要驱动因素

大温地区牙科诊所装修费用主要由三个因素决定：牙科设备预埋工程范围、BC省建筑规范对医疗 occupancy的要求，以及Fraser Health Authority的许可要求。每个因素都会增加一层一般商业承包商经常忽视的专项成本。

牙科设备预埋工程

牙科治疗椅、输送系统和X光设备需要专用电路（每椅通常20安培专用线路）、压缩空气管道、大容量吸力管道和独立排水连接。每个诊疗室的预埋工程通常在2026年需要2,500至5,500加元，具体取决于是新建成还是现有套房的更换工程。因此，三诊疗室诊所仅专业预埋一项就增加7,500至16,500加元——还不包括标准电气和管道工程。

BC省建筑规范：医疗Occupancy要求

牙科诊所在BC省建筑规范中被归类为D类（护理或带睡眠的护理） occupancy，对通风、照明和防火隔离有具体要求。主要要求包括：

  • 机械通风为诊疗室内每位占用者提供最少每小时25立方英尺的室外空气
  • HVAC系统能够保持手术/消毒区域的负压以控制空气中的颗粒物
  • 诊所与相邻商业租户之间的防火等级隔离——混合用途建筑通常要求1小时防火隔离
  • 为患者提供无障碍洗手间（包括符合BC省无障碍建筑要求的无障碍尺寸）

Fraser Health Authority许可

高贵林、Coquitlam或其他Fraser Health地区的任何牙科诊所，如果涉及X光设备，除温哥华市的标准市政建筑许可外，还需要从Fraser Health获得独立的《独立放射装置许可证》。许可申请必须包括设备规格、房间屏蔽计算（用于全景和口内X光机）和显示X光机相对于其他占用空间位置平面图。铅屏蔽要求根据CSA N855标准计算，涉及X光的项目通常额外增加3,000至8,000加元，具体取决于房间尺寸。

高贵林牙科诊所装修：2026年项目费用明细

以下是聚星裝修2026年在高贵林完成的牙科诊所的真实费用数据：

项目总费用预估$95,500–$224,500

注：这些为1,200–2,000平方英尺牙科诊所的指示性区间。新建独立诊所每平方英尺单价高于现有牙科空间装修（因为可以重复利用现有预埋工程）。拥有内部实验室或锥形束CT（CBCT）扫描室的多椅位连锁诊所将超过上限区间。

高贵林牙科诊所装修需要多长时间？

高贵林或大温地区牙科诊所装修从提交许可到移交通常需要12至20周——与BC省其他医疗商铺改造相当。许可审批时间通常是最长阶段：2026年高贵林市商业商铺改造建筑许可审批需4至8周，Fraser Health X光许可另需3至5周。三至四间诊疗室诊所的施工本身需要8至12周。

最乐观的情况下，您在签署承包商合同后约五个月才能正式开业——这是大多数牙科诊所业主在规划过渡或扩张时低估的时间线。

大温地区牙医开工前需要了解什么

如果您是在高贵林、Coquitlam、Surrey或大温其他地区规划装修的牙医或诊所老板，有三件事将决定您的成功：承包商在医疗occupancy方面的经验尽早与Fraser Health的沟通，以及施工前清晰的设备规格。

一般商业承包商经常低估牙科设备的专业预埋要求。选择在BC省完成过牙科诊所或其他D类occupancy项目的承包商，可以避免在施工中期出现代价高昂的变更单——特别是在HVAC负压规格和X光室屏蔽方面，这些错误在墙壁封闭后修复代价很高。

BC省牙科诊所装修常见问题

高贵林牙科诊所装修需要建筑许可吗？

需要。任何牙科诊所的装修——包括墙壁、地板、HVAC或管道的更改——都需要从高贵林市获得建筑许可。因为牙科诊所在BC省建筑规范中属于D类（护理） occupancy，所有工程必须按照BC省建筑规范对医疗occupancy的标准进行设计和验收。此外，如果装修涉及X光设备，在安装前需要从Fraser Health Authority获得独立的《独立放射装置许可证》。

在BC省建一间牙科诊疗室需要多少费用？

2026年大温地区装修中，每间牙科诊疗室（放置牙科治疗椅和输送系统的房间）的建造成本约为15,000至30,000加元。这包括牙科预埋（专用电路、压缩空气、大容量吸力和独立排水连接）、专用无缝乙烯基地板、感染控制的升级通风系统以及所有装修。新建工程的每诊疗室成本高于现有牙科空间装修，因为现有预埋工程可以重复利用。

牙科诊所通风的BC省建筑规范要求是什么？

BC省建筑规范要求为牙科诊疗室每位占用者提供最少每小时25立方英尺室外空气的机械通风。消毒室和手术区域必须保持相对于相邻空间的负压以控制空气传播污染。X光冲洗设备和任何使用笑气（一氧化二氮）的区域需要专用排气通风。满足这些要求的HVAC系统升级对于标准三诊疗室诊所通常需要12,000至25,000加元。

牙科诊所的Fraser Health X光许可需要多长时间？

Fraser Health Authority的《独立放射装置许可证》流程对于直截了当的牙科X光安装，在文件齐全的情况下（设备规格、按CSA N855的屏蔽计算、平面图）通常需要3至5周。涉及全景或锥形束CT（CBCT）设备的更复杂安装需要额外的屏蔽审查，可能需要6至8周。这是高贵林市建筑许可时间之外的，所以要将两者都纳入项目时间表。

一般商业承包商能否承接BC省牙科诊所装修？

一般商业承包商可以管理牙科诊所装修，但他们必须了解BC省建筑规范D类occupancy要求、Fraser Health Authority标准和牙科设备的专业预埋要求。对其中任何一项的误解都可能导致验收失败、代价高昂的整改或Fraser Health许可被拒。聚星裝修在大温地区完成了牙科诊所和其他医疗occupancy装修，熟悉包括高贵林市许可、Fraser Health X光许可和BC省建筑规范合规在内的完整监管框架。
